8b4('bum): pa stong pa nyid do/'di na ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi chos yid do zhes rnam par dkru par mya bya'o//'di ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/'dir ni thog ma dang
8b5('bum): tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyu+i do zhes rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o//'di ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do /'di ni dor ba myed pa stog pa nyid kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug
8b6('bum): par my-i bya'o/'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/'di ni rang bzhin stong ba nyid kyi chos nyid do zhes snam par dkrug par myi bya 'o//'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/'di ni chos thams cad sto
8b7('bum): pa nyid kyi chos nyid do zhe rnam par dkrug par mi bya'o//'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/'di 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid do stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid do/zhes rnam par dkrug par my-i bya'o/'di ni myi dmyigs
8b8('bum): pa stong pa nyid do/'di ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid de zhes rnam par dkrug pa mi bya'o//'di ni dngos po med pa stong pa nyid do/'di na dngos po med pa stong pa'i nyid kyi chos nyid do//zhes bya bar
9a1('bum): //rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o/'di ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/'di ni ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par myi ba'o//'di ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de/
9a2('bum): 'di ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid chos nyid do zhes rnam pa dkrug par myi bya'o//'di na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnamaso/'di ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes rnams par dkrug par
9a3('bum): mi bya'o//'di ni yang dag par spong ba rnams so/'di ni yang dag par spang ba rnams kyi chos nyid do zhe rnam par dkrug par mi bya'o/'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnamaso/'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba rnams kyi chos
9a4('bum): nyid do zhes rnam par dkrig par myi bya'o/'di dag ni dbang bo rnams so/'di ni dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes/rnam par dkrug par ma bya'o//'di dag ni stobs rnams so//'di ni stobs rnams
9a5('bum): kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam bar dkrug par myi bya'o//'d-i dag ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/'di dag ni byang chub kyi yan
9a6('bum): dag ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/'di ni 'phags pa'i lam yan yan lag brgyad pa'i chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o/'d-i dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so
9a7('bum): 'di ni 'phags pa'i bden ba rnams kyi chos nyid do/zhes rnam par dkrug par spyi bya'o//'di dag ni bsam gtan rnams so/'di ni bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid do zhe rnam par dkrug par mya bya'o/
9a8('bum): 'di dag ni tshad med pa rnams so/'di ni tshad med pa rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes rnams par dkrug par mi bya'o//'di dag ni gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnamaso/'di ni gzugs myed
9b1('bum): pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par mi bya'o//'di dag ni rnam par thard pa brgyad do/'di ni rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi chos nyid do zhes rnams par dkrug par mi
9b2('bum): bya'o/'di dag ni mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'o/'di ni mthard kyis gnas pa'i+i snyoms par 'jug pa rnam kyi chos nyid do zhes rnamapar dkrug par myi bya'o/'di dag ni
9b3('bum): rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang/smon pa med pa'o//'di ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong ba nyid dang/mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa'i chos nyid do zhes rnam parabakrug par
9b4('bum): mi bya'o/'di dag ni mngon par shes pa rnams so/'di ni mngon par shes pa rnalas kyi chos nyid do zhes rnal par dkrug par myi bya'o//'di ni ting nge 'dzin rnamaso/'di ni ting nge 'dzin
9b5('bum): rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes pa rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o //'di dag ni gzungs kyi sgo rnamaso//'di ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam pa dkrug par mi bya'o//'di dag ni
9b6('bum): de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'o/'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobasabacu'i chos nyid do zhes rnam pa'i dkrug par myi bya'o//'di dag ni mi 'jigs pa rnamaso/'di ni mi 'jigs pa rnams kyi
9b7('bum): chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par mi bya'o//'di dag ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o/'di ni so so yang dag par rangig pa rnams kyi chos nyid do zhesarnam par dkrug par mi ba'o//'di dag ni
9b8('bum): byams pa chen po'o//'di ni byams pa chen po'i chos nyid do zhes rnam paradakrug par myi bya'o//'d-i dag ni snying rje chen po'o//'di ni snying rje chen po'o//'di ni snying rje chen po'i chos nyid do zhe sa par
10a1('bum): //dkrug par myi bya'o//'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyado/'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par mi bya'o//'di ni rgyun du
10a2('bum): zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/'di ni rgyun du zhugs pa rnams kyi chos nyid ngo zhes rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o//'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o//'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid do zhes
10a3('bum): rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o//'d-i ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o'ad-i ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i'abras bu'i chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par my-i bya'o//'di ni dgra bcom pa nyid do/'di n-i dgra bcom pa nyid kyi chos
10a4('bum): nyid do zhes rnam par dkrus par mi bya'o//'di ni rang byang chub bo//'d-i ni rang byang chub kyi chos nyid do zhes rnams par dkrug par myi bya'o//'di ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa ny-id do/'di ni lam gyi rnam pa
10a5('bum): shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid do zhes rnam par dkrug par myi bya'o'adi ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do'adi ni rnam pa thams cadamakhyen pa nyid do zhes rnam par dkug par myi bya'o//chos nyid do zhes rnam par
10a6('bum): gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar chos rnams kyi chos nyid rnam par dkrug par mi bgyi ba lags na/de la de bzhin gshegs pas 'di ni gzugs nyid ngo zhes rnam par dkrug par
10a7('bum): 'd-i ni 'du byed do'adi ni rnam par shes pa'o'adi ni myig go/'di ni rna ba'o'adi ni sna'o'adi n-i lce'o'adi n-i lus so'ad-i ni yid do/'di ni gzugaso/'di ni sgra'o'adi ni dri'o'adi ni ra'o
10a8('bum): 'di ni reg go/'di ni chos so//'di ni myig gi rnam par shes pa'o'adi ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o'adi ni sna'-i rnam par shes pa'o'ad-i ni lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/'di ni lce'i rnam par shes pa'o'adi ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o
10b1('bum): 'di ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o//'di ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o//'di ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'o/'di li lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o//'di ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/
10b2('bum): 'di ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o//'ad ni mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'o//'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te rig pa' rkyen kyis tshor ba'o//'di ni sna'i 'dus ste reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bya'o//'di ni lce'i
10b3('bum): 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen ky-is tshor ba'o//'di ni lus kyi 'dus te rag pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o//'di ni yid kyi 'dus te rag pa'i rkyen
10b4('bum): me'i khamaso//'di ni rlung gi khamaso//'di ni nam mkha'i khams maso//'di ni rnam par shes pa'i khams so//'di ni ma rig pa'o//'di ni 'du byed do//'di ni rnam par shes
10b5('bum): 'di ni mying dang gzugaso//'di ni skye mched drug go//'di ni reg pa'o//'di ni tshor ba'o//'di ni sred pa'o//'di ni len pa'o//'d-i ni srid pa'o//'d-i ni skye ba'o//'d-i ni rga shi'o//'di ni sbyin
10b6('bum): pa'-i pha rold tu phyin pa'o//'di ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o//'di ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/'di ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o //'di ni bsam gtan gy-i pha rol tu phyin pa'o
10b7('bum): 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o////'di ni nang stong pa ny-id do//'di ni phyi stong pa nyid do//'d-i ni phyi nang stong pa nyid do//'d-ini stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do//'di ni chen po stong pa nyid do//'d-in ni don dam pa
10b8('bum): stong pa nyid do//'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid do//'di n-i 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do////'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do//'d-i n-i thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid do//'di ni th-ig dor ba
11a1('bum): //med pa stong pa nyid do /'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/'di ni mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/'di ni dngos
11a2('bum): po med pa stong pa nyid do/'d-i ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/'ad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de/'di dag ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/'di dag ni yang dag par spong ba rnams so/
11a3('bum): 'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/'di dag ni dbang po rnamaso/'di dag ni stobs rnamaso/'di dag ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/'di dag ni 'phags pa' lim yan lag brgyad
11a4('bum): pa'o/'di dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnamaso/'di dag ni bsam gtan rnams so/'di dag ni tshad med pa rnamaso/'di dag ni gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnamaso/
11a5('bum): 'di dag ni rnam par thard pa brgyad do/'di dag ni mthar ky-i sa gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par dgu'o/'di dag ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang
11a6('bum): smon pa myed pa'o/'di dag ni mngon par shes pa rnamaso/'di dag ni gzungs kyi sgo rnamaso/'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'o//'di dag ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi'o/'di dag
11a7('bum): n-i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o/'di dag ni byams pa chen po'o/'di dag ni snying rje chen po 'o/'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad do/'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras
11a8('bum): bu'o/'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/'di ni phyi ri mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o'adi ni dgra bcom pa nyid do/'di ni ring byang chub bo/'di ni lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid do/'di ni
11b1('bum): rnam par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/zhes rnam par dkrug par mdzad na /de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos rnams kyi chos nyid rnam par dkrug par ma gyurd tam/bcom ldan 'das
11b2('bum): kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byord de ni ma yin no/ngas ji ltar na/gzhan rnams khong du chud par 'gyur zhes ming dang /mtshan mas chos rnams kyi chos nyidabastan te/chos rnams brjod kyi
11b3('bum): chos nyid rnaM par dkrug pa myed do//gsol pa bcom ldan 'das gal te gzhan rnams khong du chud par bgyi ba'i slad du/bcom ldan 'das kyis ming dang mtshan mas chos rnams kyi chos nyid bstan te /
11b4('bum): chos rnams brjod par mdzad na/bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ming ma mchis shing mtshan ma mchis pa la mying dang mtshan mas brjod pa mdzad //bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa
11b5('bum): rab 'byord brjod pa ni mying dang ma yin/mtshan ma yang ma yin/mngon par chags pa ma yinate/rab 'byord gzhan du na sdug sngal nyid brjod par zad de/ming dang mtshan ma la
11b6('bum): mngon par chags pa myed do/rab 'byord de bzhin gshegs pa 'am/de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos ni ming dang mtshan ma la mngon par chags par mi 'gyur te/rab 'byord gal te ming la mngon
11b7('bum): par chags par 'gyur ram/mtshan ma la mngon par chag par 'gyur na ni/stong pa nyid kyang stong pa nyid la mngon par 'gyur ro/mtshan ma med pa yang mtshan ma med pa la mngon par chags
11b8('bum): par 'gyuro ba myed /smon pa med pa yang smon pa med pa la mngon par chas par 'gyur ro/de bzhin nyid kyang de bzhin nyid la mngon par chags par 'gyuro /yang dag pa'i mtha' yang yang dag pa'i mtha'
12a1('bum): @#//la mngon par chags par 'gyur ro/chos kyi dbyings kyang chos kyi dbyings la mngon par 'gyuro/'dus ma byas kyang 'dus ma byas la mngon par chags par 'gyur ro/chos nyid 'di
12a2('bum): dag thams cad kyang ming tsam du gdags par zad pas na/de dag ni ming tsam la gnas pa med do//rab 'byord de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos my-ing dang mtshan ma tsam la
12a3('bum): gnas te/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyad par bya ste/de la mngon par chags pa r-i ma bya'o//gsold pa bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar 'dus byas 'di dag thams cad ming dang mtshan
12a4('bum): ma tsam du bas pa lags na/byang chub sems dpa' sems/dpa' chen po de dag gang gi don du/byang chub sems skyed nas/'du byed du ma nyamasu myong bar bgyid pa dang /
12a5('bum): byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par lags/sbyin pa sna tshogs yongs su gtong ngam/tshul khr-ims srung ba dang/bzod pa bsgrub pa dang/brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang/
12a6('bum): ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang/shes rab sgom pa dang/nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/phyi stong pa ny-id la spyod pa dang/phy-i nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/stong pa nyid
12a7('bum): stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang /chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa /'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa  dang/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod
12a8('bum): mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod dang/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod dang/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa da/chos
12b1('bum): thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa da/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang /ngo bo nyid stong pa 
12b2('bum): nyid la spyod pa dang/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa ny-id la spyod pa dang/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa dang/yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa dang/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa
12b3('bum): rnams la spyod pa dang/dbang po rnams la spyod pa dang/stobs rnams la spyod pa dang/byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyod pa dang/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa dang/
12b4('bum): 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa dang /bsam gtan bzhi la spyod pa dang/tshad med pa bzhi la spyod pa dang/gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la spyod pa dang /
12b5('bum): rnam par thard pa brgyad la spyod pa dang/mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la spyod pa dang/rnam par thard pa'i sgo stong pa nyid la dang mtshan ma myed pa dang/
12b6('bum): smon pa myed pa la spyod pa dang/mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod pa dang/ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod pa dang/gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod pa dang/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la spyod
12b7('bum): pa dang/mi 'jigs pa bzhi la spyod pa dang/so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la spyod pa dang/byams pa chen po la spyod pa dang/snying rje chen po la spyod pa dang/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa
12b8('bum): bcwo brgyad la spyod pa lags bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byord gang de skad du gal te 'dus byas thams cad mying dang mtshan ma tsam du zad na/'on kyang gang gi don du byang chub sems dpa
13a1('bum): //sems dpa' chen po rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa ces zer ba ni/rab 'byord de ltar 'dus byas thams cad ming dang mtshan ma tsam du zad de/mying yang mying gis stong/mtshan
13a2('bum): ma yang mtshan mas stong bas na/de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyod cing/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro /
13a3('bum): chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/sems can rnams theg pa gsum gyis yongs su mya ngan las zlo ste/mying dang mtshan ma de la skye ba dang 'jig pa dang/gnas pa dang gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba mi dmyigaso
13a4('bum): gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dang/rnam pa thams cad ma khyen pa nyid ces gsungs sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byord rnam pa thams cad mkhyen
13a5('bum): pa nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyenapa nyid ces smraso//gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gsungs pa dang/lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid
13a6('bum): ces mdor gsungs pa dang/rnam pa thams cad/mkhyen pa nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs na/bcom ldan 'das rnam thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/de gsum la khyad na ci zhig mchis/rnam
13a7('bum): pa ci zhig mchis/bcom ldan 'das kyis bga' stsal pa/rab 'byord thams cad mkhyen pa nyidazhes bya ba na nyin thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la bya'o/lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa
13a8('bum): la bya'o/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la bya'ogasold pa bcom ldan 'das ji'i slad du nyan thos dang /rang sangs
13b1('bum): rgyas rnams la ni rnam pa thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya ba ci'i slad du /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal
13b2('bum): pa/rab 'byord phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa tsam gyi thams cad nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis shes te/lam thams cad du ni ma yin no//rab 'byord gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/byang chub
13b3('bum): sems dpa' sems dpa' che po rnams la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyad ces zer ba ni/rab 'byord lam thams cad byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' chen pos bsgrub par bya'o//lam thams cad byang chub
13b4('bum): sems dpa' semasadapa' che pos shes par bya ste/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgya kyi lam gang ji snyed pa dang/byang chub sems dpa'i lam gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya
13b5('bum): ba yin la/lam de dag gis kyang lam gyi bya ba bya dgos ste/yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir ro//gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sem dpa' chen
13b6('bum): pos sangs rgyas kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par bgyi 'tshal na/'o na ni des yang dag pa'i mtha' yang mngon du bgyi bar 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byord sangs rgyas kyi zhing
13b7('bum): yongasu dag par byas la/sems can yongs su smin par ma byas pas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yang dag pa'i mtha'amangon du mi bya'o//gsol pa bcom ldan 'dis ji lags/
13b8('bum): byang chub sems dpa' semasad pa chen pos lam la gnas te/yang dag pa'i mtha' mang don du bgyi 'am/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka stsal pa/de ni ma yin no/gsold pa/bcom ldan 'das 'o na
14a1('bum): //lam ma yin lags pa la gnas te 'am//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa//de ni ma yin no//gsold pa bcom ldan 'das 'o na lam yang ma lags la/lam ma lags pa yang
14a2('bum): gnas te 'am/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka'i stsal pa//de ni ma yin ni/gsol pa bcom ldan 'das 'o na' lam yang ma lags la lam ma lags pa la yang gnas te 'am/bcom ldan
14a3('bum): kyis bka' stsal pa/de ni ma yin no//gsol pa bcom ldan 'da'as 'o na ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bga'
14a4('bum): stsal pa/de ni mi yin no//gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'o na ji ltar byang chub kyis sems dpa' sems dpa' sems dpa'i sems dpa' chen pos/yang dag pa'i mtha' mngonadu bgyi/bcom ldan 'das
14a5('bum): kyis bka' stsal pa/de ji snyam du sems//khyod lam la gnas pas nye bar len pa myed par zag pa la sems rnam par grol lam/gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/de ni ma lags so/
